csv_project_name: Design for Middle Bay Road Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: Town of Brunswick may be seeking Design service for Middle Bay Road Improvements. Middle Bay Road is being considered for a road widening project to better accommodate pedestrians and cyclists. It is currently a 1.2 mile road that is about 24 ft wide, with drainage ditches and variable width gravel shoulders. The town engineer commissioned a survey which identified numerous utility and drainage concerns if the road was to be widened for bike lanes. The town engineer is requesting funding for a design consultant to evaluate different alternatives for accommodating bicycle and pedestrian activity (widening the road, a dedicated multimodal path, necessary drainage changes, resolving utility conflicts, etc.)
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Sanitation Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering
